<!-- pr-reviewer: e10ba5ba32a77031856cbf6c0819695813d0d525 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY. The change moves the pass starts of 2D pocket and adaptive toolpaths. Thus it changes the posted G-code.

### What looks good
- The fix is small and local to `non_sliver_center` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:239-252`). When the sliver scan removes nothing, the function returns the plain `region.offset(-erode)`. This is the same output as before #2383.
- The sliver drop of #2232 stays. When the scan removes a sliver, the `from_slices` rebuild still applies.
- The new pin `non_sliver_tests::a_multi_piece_center_without_slivers_is_the_plain_offset` compares the full region (loops and start vertices), not only the area.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside tests. The test fixtures use `let ... else { panic!() }` inside `#[cfg(test)]` only.
- `pocket.rs` is 371 lines (below 400).
- The PR moves no goldens (no change in `tests/golden/`). #2383 moved no goldens too. Thus the output without slivers is the same as before #2383, and no golden must move back.
- No UI change, no process file, no `build.rs`, no `scripts/`, no `.github/`, no dependency change.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2426-adaptive-entry-red.md` has the correct format (what, why, considered and dropped, cost to change later).
- The body has "what changed", "how tested", "not exercised", a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2426`. The commit subject is a conventional `fix(motion):`.

### Results (merged with main, locally)
The PR head already contains `upstream/main` 3e47b898b. The trial merge says "Already up to date". All runs are local, on Linux, on head e10ba5ba3.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 20 steps, 0 failed (63.8 min) |
| motion lib | 416 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored (the new pin passes) |
| motion: adaptive_hsm, climb_direction, corner_arc_radius, corner_blend, entry_arc, optimal_load, predrilled_entry, refusal_ghost, rest_zigzag, rest2d, shape_masks, solid_law, top_z_level, xy_arc_entry | all pass |
| app: pick_agnostic | 5 passed, 2 ignored |
| app: pocket_overhead | 2 passed |
| app: solid_law_goldens | 7 passed |
| motion: adaptive_entry_pieces (the red test of #2426) | 5 passed |
| app: shoulder_adaptive (the suite of #2383) | 9 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutations (run by the reviewer)
1. Disable the fix (`if !dropped` changed to `if false && !dropped`, `pocket.rs:250`):
   - `adaptive_entry_pieces::a_narrow_second_piece_names_its_ramp_stand_in_at_each_level`: RED. The failure text is the same as in #2426 (the pass start is at (56.000, 6.000), not at (56.000, 5.000)).
   - `non_sliver_tests::a_multi_piece_center_without_slivers_is_the_plain_offset`: RED. The loops start at a different vertex.
   - Revert: GREEN.
2. Always return the plain offset, also when a sliver is found (`if true || !dropped`, `pocket.rs:250`):
   - `shoulder_adaptive::outside_containment_without_stock_refuses_naming_extension`: RED.
   - `shoulder_adaptive::containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess`: RED ("the band plans in seconds, not minutes").
   - Revert: GREEN. Thus the sliver drop of #2232 stays pinned.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. The gate map of `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_entry_pieces.rs:9-10` does not name `machining2d::pocket`. Thus the quick gate of #2383 did not run this suite, and the regression went to main. We recommend a small follow-up (P7) that adds `pocket` to this gate map.
2. The PR is a draft at the time of this review. Mark it ready before the merge.
3. The body has two generated lines after `Fixes #2426`. This is not a problem for GitHub, because the closing keyword still applies.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e10ba5ba32a77031856cbf6c0819695813d0d525 -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The fix returns the plain offset region when the sliver scan drops nothing. The `Region::from_slices` rebuild now runs only when a sliver is actually removed. This removes the unintended vertex re-start of #2383 for every multi-piece area. (crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs)
- `docs/decisions/2426-adaptive-entry-red.md` records the cause, the dropped options and the pinning tests. It matches the code.
- The new test `a_multi_piece_center_without_slivers_is_the_plain_offset` pins the exact loops and start vertices.
- No unsafe prints: the only `panic!` calls are in the new `#[cfg(test)]` fixture code. The refusal path is unchanged.
- The commit subject is conventional, the body has the `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #2426`. It names itself as a #2383 regression fix.

## Results, merged with main

Trial merge with `origin/main` (`3e47b898b`) had no conflicts; the merge commit was local only, never pushed. Built locally in the review worktree.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --test adaptive_entry_pieces` (the #2426 test) | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-motion --lib non_sliver` (new pinning test) | 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test shoulder_adaptive` | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-motion` lib suite | 467 passed, 0 failed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

Red main (#2426) goes green with this merge, on my own re-runs above.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The sliver threshold (`1e-2` area, `dive_room 0.008`) is unchanged from #2383. Correct for this fix; a separate issue may want the two numbers named as constants. Not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
